name: lorewardens
description: Modular multi-agent fiction continuity checking. Non-destructive findings against a living, writer-owned Canon.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lorewardens/core && npm run build -w @lorewardens/agents && npm run build -w @lorewardens/mcp-server && npm run build -w @lorewardens/bridge && npm run build -w @lorewardens/proof && npm run build -w @lorewardens/docs-extension
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @lorewardens/core && npm run test -w @lorewardens/agents && npm run test -w @lorewardens/mcp-server && npm run test -w @lorewardens/bridge && npm run test -w @lorewardens/proof && npm run test -w @lorewardens/docs-extension
